Microsoft Edge seems to be the best way to compress a PDF file as small as possible. This helps when trying to send via email.

Right-click the file and choose to open in Microsoft Edge

![](data:image/png;base64,)

Once open in Edge, Click the 3 dots in the top right of the window and hit Print

![[Pasted image 20241231125742.png]]

Select Print to pdf, then name and save.

![[Pasted image 20241231125816.png]]

Below you can see the original and new size (Nearly 1mb difference)
![[Pasted image 20241231125846.png]]
